scope: Outdoor palace envelope of Palazzo del Bo, the Old and New Courtyards and the six-tier anatomical theatre associated with the Old Court wing, in its preserved early twenty-first-century form.

originalReview.notes: The original upload and Commons native grant name Kalibos and Marco Bisello. Wikimedia account records and subsequent republications corroborate the photographer credit. The original shows curved carved timber balusters, oval wood rings and the central observation pit.

The March 2024 photograph shows the Old Court’s two loggias, classical columns, pale stone balustrades, continuous decorative entablature and the higher rendered wall behind the gallery. The source is the original photographer’s upload and CC0 waiver.

quallaSearch.notes: The published Qualla photograph was selected first for the theatre. The verified own-work CC0 photograph supplements the sixteenth-century Old Court. The source sites also offer written architectural controls. The published Listòn street photograph has conflicting native permission tags and was excluded.
